cadence: Routine coverage every six hours, with final pregame collection prioritized by the kickoff worker. First/last TD are sportsbook prices only, not ATTD model probabilities.

monthlyQuotaPolicy.policy: Protect core pregame yardage and touchdown coverage across the remaining cycle. Routine previews use a capped share of surplus. Replenishment is detected from provider-reported balances; no replacement key or paid upgrade is automatic.
